title: बालसाहित्यको सैद्धान्तिक पर्यावलोकन {A Theoretical Overview of Children's Literature}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख बालसाहित्यको अध्ययनमा आधारित रहेको छ । यस लेखमा बालसाहित्यको सैद्धान्तिक पर्यावलोकन गरिएको छ । बालसाहित्यको परिचय दिनु, बालसाहित्यको परम्परा पहिल्याउनु, बालसाहित्यका प्रकार प्रस्तुत गर्नु र बालसाहित्यका तत्वबारे चर्चा गर्नु प्रस्तुत अध्ययनका मूलभूत उद्देश्य रहेका छन् । यो अध्ययन मूलत: गुणात्मक अनुसन्धानमा आधारित रहेको छ । यस अध्ययनमा वर्णनात्मक तथा विश्लेषणात्मक पद्धतिको अनुप्रयोग गरिएको छ । यसमा आवश्यक सामग्रीहरुको सङ्कलन पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययनकाका माध्यमबाट गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा द्वितीयक स्रोतका सामग्रीहरुको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस क्रममा मुख्यत: नेपाली र अङ्ग्रेजी सैद्धान्तिक सामग्रीहरूको उपयोग गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनबाट बालसाहित्य बालबालिकाका लागि लेखिएको साहित्यका रूपमा रहेको, यो प्रौढ साहित्यभन्दा भिन्न  एबम पृथक रहेको, यसको परम्परा पूर्वीय र पाश्चात्य रूपमा भिन्न भिन्न रहेको भए पनि सुदीर्घ रहेको, यस अन्तर्गत बाल कविता, बाल कथा, बाल जीवनी, बाल एकाङ्की, बाल उपन्यास, अनूदित बालसाहित्य जस्ता अनेकन भेद रहेका, यसमा विषयवस्तु, परिवेश, भाषाशैली, उद्देश्य साझा तत्वा अवयवका रूपमा रहेका लगायतका निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययन बालसाहित्यका बारेमा सैद्धान्तिक जानकारी लिन चाहने जोकोहीका लागि पनि उपयोगी हुने विश्वास लिइएको छ ।
american_english: This paper is based on a study of children’s literature. This paper has conducted a theoretical overview of children’s literature. To introduce children’s literature, to introduce the tradition of children’s literature, to present the types of children’s literature and to discuss the elements of children’s literature are the basic objectives of the present study. This study is mainly based on qualitative research. This study has applied the descriptive and analytical methods. Necessary materials were collected through library research. Secondary source materials were used in the present study. In this context, mainly Nepali and English theoretical materials were used. This study has concluded that children’s literature is literature written for children, is different and separate from adult literature, is long-standing even though its tradition is different as Eastern and Western, and that it includes various types such as children's poetry, children's stories, children's biographies, children's plays, children's novels, translated children's literature, including themes, settings, language style, and objectives as common elements. This study is believed to be useful for anyone who wants to get theoretical information about children’s literature.
british_english: This paper is grounded in a study of children's literature. The paper provides a theoretical review of children's literature, aiming to introduce the subject, explore its tradition, outline its various types, and discuss its key elements. The study primarily adopts a qualitative research methodology, employing both descriptive and analytical approaches. Information was gathered predominantly through library-based research, utilising secondary sources, primarily in Nepali and English theoretical literature. The research concludes that children's literature is a distinct genre written specifically for children, separate from adult literature, with a long history that varies between Eastern and Western traditions. It encompasses multiple forms including poetry, stories, biographies, plays, novels, and translated works, sharing common features such as themes, settings, language style, and objectives. The study is intended to be a valuable resource for those seeking theoretical insights into children's literature.
australian_english: This paper is based on a study of children's literature. The paper presents a theoretical overview of children's literature, seeking to introduce the concept, explain its tradition, illustrate its various types, and discuss its fundamental elements. The study employs a primarily qualitative research design, using descriptive and analytical methods. Information was collected largely through library research, drawing on secondary sources in both Nepali and English theoretical literature. The research finds that children's literature is a distinct form of writing created for children, separate from adult literature, with a long-standing tradition that differs between Eastern and Western cultures. It includes numerous genres such as poetry, stories, biographies, plays, novels, and translated works, characterised by shared elements like themes, settings, language style, and purposes. The study is believed to be useful for anyone interested in theoretical knowledge about children's literature.
